title: 云计算与SaaS产业结构分析
core_insight: 云计算领域主要变化集中在云厂商技术层面，特别是AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azure和Cloudflare在AI、安全和网络管理方面的进展

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出了Lambda MicroVMs，Google Cloud在云原生和容器化方面有所进步，Microsoft Azure推出新版Azure Storage AWS推出了Amazon EC2 G7实例，采用NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs，Google Cloud的数据安全和AI计算能力有所增强 Run isolated sandboxes with full lifecycle control: AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs Enhanced data resilience with cross-region backups in Backup and DR Service Modernize your data with Azure Storage: Plan and migrate with confidence Verifiable, private AI: Google Cloud expands Confidential Computing frontiers Introducing the Cloudflare One stack: agent-powered deployment
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Azure Cobalt 200 VMs推出，性能提高50% 火山引擎发布新云产品，包括大数据研发治理套件等 New Azure Cobalt 200 VMs deliver 50% performance improvement, fully optimized for modern agentic AI workloads 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵
dimension_texts.application: Microsoft Azure推出Microsoft Discovery，用于企业数据发现和分析 火山引擎发布新云产品，包括大数据研发治理套件等 Announcing Microsoft Discovery general availability and Microsoft Discovery app preview 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵
dimension_texts.capital: Strella获得1400万美元的Series A融资，用于扩展其AI驱动的客户研究业务 今日无相关估值或并购信息 Cloudflare扩大了其在AI方面的投资，重点关注机器学习基础设施和效率 Amazon and Chobani adopt Strella's AI interviews for customer research as fast-growing startup raises $14M Growing the Cloudflare AI team with talent from Ensemble AI
dimension_texts.risk: 数据安全和AI伦理的讨论有所增加 今日无相关供应链或地缘风险信息 Tokenization takes the lead in the fight for data security
